operation_details.item: The user prefers engineering-style technical specifications with API endpoints and data schemas in campaign briefs instead of audience personas and brand voice.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! How’s the campaign planning going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty well. I’m drafting the brief for our customer engagement campaign and want it to be practical for the product and engineering teams.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Are you planning to lead with audience personas and brand voice guidance?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Not usually. I prefer engineering-style technical specifications, including API endpoints, event flows, and data schemas, rather than persona profiles and brand-voice sections.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds useful for keeping the campaign executable. You could structure it around the trigger events, request and response formats, consent handling, and success criteria.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I still want the customer and brand objectives covered, but translated into clear system requirements and measurable behaviors.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Completely forget my preference that For campaign briefs, I want engineering-style technical specifications with API endpoints and data schemas instead of audience personas and brand voice.
